name: InteractiveComputerGraphics/PositionBasedDynamics
description: Library for physically-based simulation of rigid bodies, deformable solids, cloth, and fluids using position-based and XPBD constraint methods. Prioritizes speed and stability for interactive applications with Python bindings.
score_rationale: 2.2k-star unified PBD simulation library covering cloth, soft body, rigid body, and fluids — the reference implementation for PBD methods.
summary: Unified PBD library for cloth, fluids, and rigid body simulation
